title: The Vote Hides the Failure: Aggregation Choice and Noise Robustness in Heart Murmur Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.37161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Noise robustness in automated phonocardiogram (PCG) murmur detection, and how it is measured, remains underexamined despite growing interest in low-resource screening. We evaluate two independently reimplemented pipelines, Hierarchical Multi-Scale Convolutional Network (HMS-Net)--CNN, and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM)--LSTM, under controlled, multi-severity noise with noise-augmented fine-tuning and held-out generalization testing. Under matched aggregation, the complete BiLSTM pipeline outperforms the complete HMS-Net pipeline across all conditions in accuracy and Weighted Accuracy. A stable aggregate accuracy score can misrepresent what individual predictions show: HMS-Net's native aggregation degrades under salt-and-pepper noise far less than majority-vote (MV) aggregation at the same severity, a gap reflecting window-level disagreement its native rule absorbs, while BiLSTM's MV accuracy rises after noise-augmented tra

translated_title: 投票掩盖了失败：心脏杂音检测中的聚合方式选择与噪声鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 尽管低资源筛查日益受到关注，自动心音图（PCG）杂音检测中的噪声鲁棒性及其测量方式仍缺乏充分研究。我们在受控的、多种严重程度的噪声条件下，评估了两条独立重新实现的流水线——分层多尺度卷积网络（HMS-Net）-CNN和双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）-LSTM，并采用了噪声增强微调和留出集泛化测试。在匹配的聚合方式下，完整的BiLSTM流水线在所有条件下的准确率和加权准确率均优于完整的HMS-Net流水线。一个稳定的总体准确率分数可能会掩盖个体预测所反映的实际情况：在相同严重程度的椒盐噪声下，HMS-Net的原生聚合方式的性能退化远小于多数投票（MV）聚合方式，这一差距反映了其原生规则所吸收的窗口级预测分歧，而BiLSTM的MV准确率在噪声增强训练后则有所上升……
tldr: 该研究发现聚合方式的选择会深刻影响心脏杂音检测噪声鲁棒性的评估结果——看似稳定的总体准确率可能掩盖模型在窗口级预测上的失败，HMS-Net的原生聚合在椒盐噪声下的性能退化远小于多数投票聚合。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that aggregation choice profoundly affects noise robustness assessment in heart murmur detection—a stable aggregate accuracy can mask window-level prediction failures, with HMS-Net's native aggregation degrading far less under salt-and-pepper noise than majority-vote aggregation.
